calculation.renderer_raw: reshape16 to4x4 Gf row-vector world-to-camera; transpose then inverse -> column world-from-camera
calculation.position: Euclidean norm of world translations; metres
calculation.timestamp_note: Sensor RenderingTime is engine clock; observation is episode elapsed. Actual clocks retained; no time stamps rewritten.

previous_control_USD_correspondence.limitation: A transform matching a preceding USD observation suggests pipeline/interpolation age; this is not by itself proof of exact RGB exposure latency.

side_visibility_review.method: Manual review of actual first/middle/last native side frames and saved dual-view sample panel; no per-pixel visibility ground truth.
side_visibility_review.full_scene: Side frame includes complete robot and single instrument; rack is much smaller than robot/instrument in wide FOV.
side_visibility_review.source_limitation: Franka hand/forearm partly occludes source rack and target cup during approach/grasp/initial extraction. Side view alone cannot verify finger contact and millimetre-scale source-bottom movement.
side_visibility_review.wrist_complement: Actual wrist view resolves rack cells, the held vessel and the fingers more clearly; it is a separate physical hand-mounted sensor.
